pokedexEntries.di: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

pokedexEntries.prl: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

pokedexEntries.pt: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It is said that a WORMADAM that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

pokedexEntries.la: The cloak—fashioned from plant matter—has merged with the Pokémon and is now part of the body, like fur or skin. I suspect this fusion is an effect of the energy involved in evolution.
